bounds.domain: Seven PR lanes. Each settles once to success, failure, cancellation or skipped. Six must succeed. Quint must succeed for a pull request into main and be skipped for every other pull request and merge candidate. One aggregate evaluation follows all terminal results. Whole-workflow cancellation before aggregate dispatch cancels its gate. The named Quint lane additionally joins four shards and one complete source-bound evidence partition; changed and unchanged source are separate cases.
bounds.assumptions: GitHub dependency scheduling prevents the aggregate from running before all needs settle. GitHub supplies the workflow cancellation status separately from dependency outcomes. The hook reads the actual YAML dependency/result lists, checks both job conditions and executes the actual shell gates. The shard validator binds each declared case, required command and exact input hash to current source; its adversarial and actual-runner tests execute in conformance.
bounds.limitations: The model does not prove GitHub service availability, job contents, branch-rule deployment, administrator bypass policy, arbitrary changes to mandatory lanes, or cancellation after aggregate dispatch. GitHub owns dispatch and interruption of running jobs. Cancelled workflows remain non-success outcomes.
